heading: 7.3 Modifiers
text:
### 7.3 Modifiers [LUNI.7.3]

`tolerance` and the other slot modifiers attach to unit-typed fields
normally. A `tolerance` literal carries no unit ([LGRA.5.1]): it is a
difference in the field's declared unit, and the compiler converts it to the
base unit by scale only ([LUNI.7.4]).
